## Featured Projects

### [Document Knowledge Base API](https://github.com/ArashHafiz/knowledgebase)

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3776AB?style=for-the-badge&logo=python&logoColor=yellow) 
![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-009688?style=for-the-badge&logo=fastapi&logoColor=white) 
![SQLAlchemy](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLAlchemy-D71F00?style=for-the-badge&logo=sqlalchemy&logoColor=white) 
![SQLite](https://img.shields.io/badge/SQLite-003B57?style=for-the-badge&logo=sqlite&logoColor=white) 
![Google Gemini](https://img.shields.io/badge/google%20gemini-%238E75B2.svg?style=for-the-badge&logo=google%20gemini&logoColor=white) 
![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/typescript-%23007ACC.svg?style=for-the-badge&logo=typescript&logoColor=white) 
![React.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/react.js-%2320232a.svg?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=%2361DAFB)

A full-stack application for storing documents, searching them, and asking questions answered by an LLM from the retrieved passages.

- FastAPI REST backend with SQLAlchemy and SQLite for document storage.
- Custom keyword retrieval pipeline with IDF-weighted ranking.
- Gemini-generated answers grounded in retrieved passages, returned with source citations.
- React and TypeScript frontend for uploading, browsing, searching and asking questions.

### [Command-Line Scientific Calculator](https://github.com/ArashHafiz/calculator)
![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3776AB?style=for-the-badge&logo=python&logoColor=yellow)

A feature-rich command-line calculator developed in Python, supporting mathematical operations, scientific calculations, unit conversions and statistical analysis.

- Basic and advanced arithmetic, including logarithms, surds and quadratic equations.
- Geometric calculations covering areas, volumes and surface areas.
- Unit conversions across length, area, volume and mass.
- Statistical functions, including mean, median, mode, range and interquartile range (IQR).
- Input validation and modular calculation functions.
